task: Preserve sealed release-unit source provenance across trusted fresh reevaluation so canonical material obligation comparison stays stable without weakening real drift detection.

operationalIntelligence.problemStatement: Live bounded rehearsal persisted U01 as STALE with RELEASE_UNIT_EXECUTION_OBLIGATION_DRIFT after bot-PR CI dispatch was fixed and main advanced to 95b0e429e5e7d23b361fa3644f0899e07b6e7ac0. The fresh reevaluation projects the same twelve create operations but scripts/release-unit-github-runtime.mjs deliberately deletes operation.source and returns an unsealed fresh manifest. The persisted manifest is sealed to source commit 65e52ffd1fd32f14353467eb7c52b2e06ba1be65, so canonical comparison sees false material operations drift and a different childOperationDigest even though file scope and operation kinds are unchanged.
observableOutcomes: Trusted fresh reevaluation returns a manifest sealed to the exact persisted execution source commit before AUTHORIZE obligation comparison.
For unchanged operations, sealed source provenance (mode, source commit, blob SHA and file mode) is reproduced deterministically and childOperationDigest remains stable.
Real material operation drift, source blob drift, dependency drift, forbidden/read-only drift and risk BLOCK remain fail-closed.
Reprojectable child-plan/governance evidence may still refresh only through the trusted two-pass reevaluation path.
The persisted U01 rehearsal can resume from STALE without manual state edits, receipt fabrication, branch rebasing or gate bypass.
unresolvedRisks: Normalizing provenance away from drift comparison would weaken tamper detection and is therefore not acceptable.
Resealing against current main rather than the immutable release execution source would bind the wrong content identity.
Double sealing must remain deterministic and must not alter already correct source provenance.
Generated/regenerate and delete operation provenance semantics must remain unchanged.
The repair must not authorize a stale child when the source blob no longer matches the sealed source commit.

in: Reseal the trusted fresh reevaluation manifest against the exact release execution sourceCommit before it is returned for AUTHORIZE comparison.
Preserve existing source deletion during intermediate semantic projection if needed, but restore canonical sealed provenance before material obligation classification.
Add regressions proving unchanged sealed operations remain equal after fresh reevaluation and real material/source drift still blocks.
Replay the live persisted U01 state after merge.
out: No removal of source provenance from canonical obligation identity.
No addition of source fields to REPROJECTABLE_OBLIGATION_FIELDS.
No threshold, risk, Truth, lifecycle or drift-gate relaxation.
No manual modification of control-plane/release-state branches or child PR receipts.
No storefront, Builder, Template Factory, database, auth, payment or inventory changes.

assuranceCeiling.rationale: The defect sits in the trusted release executor between fresh semantic reprojection and material authorization. A false PASS could merge altered material, while a false STALE blocks resumability; exact provenance and fail-closed drift semantics therefore require critical-practical proof.

acceptanceCriteria: A fresh reevaluation of a sealed release unit with unchanged operations produces equivalent normalized material operations including source provenance.
The refreshed childOperationDigest equals the persisted digest when material operations and immutable source are unchanged.
Trusted governance/child-plan reprojection may change allowed reprojectable fields without creating false material drift.
Changing operation kind, file, source commit, blob SHA or file mode remains material drift and blocks authorization.
prepareActiveUnit can move the live U01 from STALE to READY/materialization using current main without manually rewriting persisted state.
Exact-head CI, Completion Truth and Lifecycle close before merge, followed by unchanged rehearsal replay.
invariants: Sealed source provenance is execution identity, not disposable presentation metadata.
Fresh reevaluation must bind to executionSourceCommit/sourceCommit, never current-main content.
Only trusted fresh projection may refresh reprojectable governance/evidence fields.
Persisted CAS state remains the sole release execution state authority.

failureModes: Fresh semantic projection strips sealed source provenance and causes false operations drift.
Resealing uses a wrong source commit and silently changes blob identity.
A real operation/source change is normalized away and incorrectly authorized.
Generated/delete operation semantics regress during resealing.
Live persisted STALE state cannot recover after the code fix.
edgeCases: All material operations are create operations from one immutable source commit.
A delete operation legitimately has source:null.
A generated regenerate operation has regenerate provenance rather than a sealed blob.
Fresh childPlanDigest changes while operationDigest must remain stable.
Current main is many commits ahead of the immutable rehearsal source.
The prior child PR remains open on an obsolete base while a superseding materialization is required.

alternatives.summary: Reseal trusted fresh reevaluation output against the immutable execution source before AUTHORIZE comparison.
alternatives.reason: Preserves exact provenance and digest semantics while keeping all existing material drift checks intact.

alternatives.summary: Strip operation.source from normalized obligation comparison and operation digest semantics.
alternatives.reason: Would weaken provenance/tamper detection and erase a material execution identity dimension.

alternatives.summary: Edit persisted U01 state or manifest to remove sealed source metadata.
alternatives.reason: Would bypass the canonical CAS/runtime path and invalidate the production-like rehearsal.

specialistReviews.finding: The false drift is introduced between trusted reevaluation projection and AUTHORIZE, not in decomposition scope.
specialistReviews.resolution: Restore sealed execution identity at the boundary before comparison.

specialistReviews.finding: Ignoring source metadata would permit altered source content to look obligation-equivalent.
specialistReviews.resolution: Keep source provenance material and reseal from the exact immutable sourceCommit.

specialistReviews.finding: A stale persisted child must be recoverable after policy/runtime fixes without re-authoring its material intent.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use trusted reevaluation plus deterministic resealing, then replay persisted U01 through normal AUTHORIZE/materialize/CI/merge.

specialistReviews.finding: The observed blocker is a newly discovered execution-edge regression and must remain visible until replay proves closure.
specialistReviews.resolution: Add regression proof and replay the same live rehearsal after merge.

challenge.scenario: Persisted manifest is sealed; fresh projection has identical operation kind/file but no source object.
challenge.resolution: Seal fresh output with the exact sourceCommit before AUTHORIZE.

challenge.scenario: Fresh projection changes a file or operation kind.
challenge.finding: Resealing must not make this look equivalent.
challenge.resolution: Keep operation list material; only attach provenance to the projected operations and preserve drift comparison.

challenge.scenario: Source file content changed at another commit.
challenge.finding: Using current main would produce a different blob and could conceal source identity error.
challenge.resolution: Always seal against immutable execution sourceCommit supplied by the executor.

challenge.scenario: Fresh child plan is legitimately reprojected due current governance while material files are identical.
challenge.finding: Plan digest may change even when operation digest should not.
challenge.resolution: Continue trusted reprojectable-field handling while preserving stable sealed operation digest.

challenge.scenario: U01 old PR is still open on a960 base.
challenge.finding: Reusing it after main advance would violate lease.
challenge.resolution: Let existing supersession/materialization logic create or select the canonical current-main child after reevaluation passes.

proofPlan: Commit this plan only and require Plan Before Code PASS before implementation.
Implement deterministic resealing of the fresh reevaluation manifest against sourceCommit at the trusted reevaluation boundary.
Add regression proof for stable source provenance/operation digest plus fail-closed real source/material drift.
Require exact-head Knowledge/Plan/Edit-Time/Incremental Replay/Release Risk/full tests/typecheck/build/Completion Truth/Lifecycle PASS.
Merge only on exact-head proof, then replay the unchanged persisted multi-unit rehearsal and follow every new blocker through Failure Intake.

requirements.requirement: Trusted fresh release-unit reevaluation must preserve immutable sealed source provenance and stable operation identity when material intent is unchanged, while real operation or source drift remains fail-closed.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: A sealed persisted release-unit operation may not be compared to an unsealed fresh operation as though provenance were disposable.
A change to operation kind, file or immutable source identity may not be accepted as a trusted reprojectable governance refresh.

requirements.requirement: Fresh authorization after resealing must remain inside the canonical Release Risk Budget and exact current-main lease.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Resealing may not authorize a release unit when canonical Release Risk or current-main lease blocks it.

notes: Plan-only transaction created from live persisted rehearsal state after main 95b0e429e5e7d23b361fa3644f0899e07b6e7ac0. U01 is STALE with RELEASE_UNIT_EXECUTION_OBLIGATION_DRIFT solely because trusted fresh reevaluation removes sealed operation.source provenance and changes childOperationDigest. No implementation is authorized until Plan Before Code passes.
